# [STORY] As an operator, I want free-tier IaC for Azure and AWS with Kubernetes manifests, so that the platform can run on real cloud infrastructure within a $0 budget

## User Story
**As an** operator
**I want** free-tier IaC for Azure and AWS with Kubernetes manifests
**So that** the platform can run on real cloud infrastructure within a $0 budget

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given Terraform apply runs against Azure or AWS, when the cluster comes up, then the core services deploy via the Kustomize overlays and stay within free-tier limits
- [x] Given terraform destroy runs, when the round-trip completes, then no billable resources are left running
